answer_1.quote: To empirically evaluate the improvements provided by using SpecDiff, the paper provides an empirical analysis on three standard natural language processing tasks: (1) text summarization using the CNN/DM dataset , (2) text generation on the OpenWebText (OWT) dataset , and (3) text generation using MT Bench .
answer_1.outputs: The outputs include generated text sequences evaluated for speed, acceptance rate, and computational efficiency.

answer_2.quote: Our method is assessed empirically by walltime speedup, acceptance rate α, and total floating point operations (FLOPs).
